scope: Explicitly authorized one-relay generic QUIC listener trial; prior complete playout capture analysis and opt-in TCP diagnostics.

canary.binary: clean SDK 3f1b69ba / CLI 0.11.42, unchanged in this cycle

policy: Generic UDP listener only; no media classification, preferential service or role hint added. Client bootstrap override is stand-local and temporary. Calls do not use mailbox.

failure_and_recovery.first_add: Validated extra listener and hot reload initially succeeded.
failure_and_recovery.second_same_config_reload: Failed with EADDRINUSE. Health stalled with tick 2610 and zero sessions despite listeners appearing in admin output.
failure_and_recovery.recovery: Cold restart of only the authorized canary retained the candidate; health ok with advancing ticks and active sessions. No rollback needed.
failure_and_recovery.open_defect: QUIC reload teardown/rebind failure is not fixed. Do not retry hot reload as a recovery procedure. Investigate endpoint lifetime; exact retaining owner not proved.

prior_playout_analysis.inputs: Complete bounded audio.playout traces from prior audio-only and video runs. Observed count equals parsed rows and remains below capture limit on all four endpoints.
prior_playout_analysis.result: No callback requests a target above its applied target ceiling. Prior target-cap conflict hypothesis does not reproduce. Mac video render loop max gap 11.043 ms, no gaps above 30 ms, despite eight audio interruptions; simple late render callbacks do not explain those interruptions.
prior_playout_analysis.limits: Cumulative trimming is discarded audio duration, not a maximum pause. Does not attribute loss or delay to a network hop.

diagnostics.change: Opt-in TCP trace records stable local connection id, local/remote port pair and TCP_NODELAY for correlation with a separate socket inventory; no IP/payload/role/wire or socket option changes.
diagnostics.limits: Join only unambiguous port-pair/generation matches; exact RTP/lane-to-hop attribution remains open.

physical_retry.endpoints: Same private 3f1b/db197 stand clients; TCP metadata SDK 323e8c39 is not installed.
physical_retry.pre_and_post_call: Both endpoints retain an active QUIC canonical session to the canary. Independent local-slot admissions via that peer observed, alongside other TCP/ordered relay admissions. This is a mixed route, not an isolated all-QUIC media path.
physical_retry.p2p_video: 45-85 s: actual received 6.294 / 4.110 fps, zero new audio interruptions.
physical_retry.relay: Requested at 91.060 s; total native interruption counters finish at 24 / 11. Final 59.464 s receives 2 / 6 new frames (0.034 / 0.101 fps), both source-held throughout.
physical_retry.buffer_and_pacer: Sampled audio jitter-buffer maxima 351 / 186 ms; pacer maxima 1217 / 0 ms. These are maxima of sampled state, not peak end-to-end speech delay.
physical_retry.trimmed_audio: Last sampled cumulative discarded audio 15770 / 9790 ms; complete final playout trace 15850 / 9840 ms (includes teardown after last sample). Sums are not individual pauses.
physical_retry.render: Complete bounded playout traces: no target above applied ceiling; Mac max render gap 11.750 ms with zero gaps over 30 ms, phone max gap 32.506 ms (one).

remaining: Prove useful video and audio quality on actual QUIC relay paths.
Fix same-config QUIC reload leaving node stalled.
Hot-standby replacement currently carries only a byte stream and clears independent media handles; typed transport handoff needs a safe fix that cannot reuse AEAD nonces.
Repeated trimming at 60-ms packet headroom and target/ceiling 60 ms merits a real-NetEq timing regression before changing playout protection. This does not by itself prove an algorithmic cause.
post_call_canary_health: Health ok, ticks 809 -> 812, six sessions; UDP 8443 bound, candidate config SHA unchanged.
